reading.title: A greener delivery plan
reading.passage: The town council wants local businesses to cut delivery emissions. One proposal is to create a shared collection point near the market, allowing several shops to use fewer vehicle trips. Supporters say this could reduce fuel use, while critics argue that small farms might need extra time to organise combined deliveries.

writing.title: Opinion essay: greener deliveries

steps: Introduce the issue and your position.
Explain the first view with reasons/examples.
Explain the other view with reasons/examples.
Conclude without adding a new main idea.

reading.passage: A proposed subsidy would help farms replace old delivery vehicles with cleaner models. The programme has no environmental goal
